55cb2ed3cc6fddd90f5a.en: The red part has 6 units and the blue part has 3 units. Together they make 9 units.
55cb2ed3cc6fddd90f5a.id: Bagian merah berisi 6 unit dan bagian biru berisi 3 unit. Kalau digabung, semuanya 9 unit.

8f4e4940bf7ed3cb1795.en: The morning part has 7 units and the afternoon part has 4 units. Together they make 11 units.
8f4e4940bf7ed3cb1795.id: Bagian pagi berisi 7 unit dan bagian sore berisi 4 unit. Kalau digabung, semuanya 11 unit.

3a051b82b1a5852429de.en: The story part has 5 units and the picture part has 8 units. The whole is 13 units.
3a051b82b1a5852429de.id: Bagian buku cerita berisi 5 unit dan bagian buku bergambar berisi 8 unit. Keseluruhannya 13 unit.
